description: Use this when you need current US severe-weather alerts (NWS, including a lat/lon point filter), tropical storms, rivers in flood and FAA TFRs. Free. License: cleared. Attribution required: NOAA / National Weather Service (https://www.weather.gov/). NOAA / National Hurricane Center (https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/). NOAA National Water Prediction Service (https://water.noaa.gov/). FAA TFR list (https://tfr.faa.gov/). Not for navigation or flight planning.

lat.description: Optional WGS84 latitude for NWS point alerts (requires lon).

lon.description: Optional WGS84 longitude for NWS point alerts (requires lat).

state.description: Two-letter USPS state filter (also matches NWS zone text).

name: get_severe_weather
title: US severe weather (NWS, NHC, NWPS, FAA TFR)
